title: Aakhri sajda
body:
hilne laga arshe bareen
rone lagi karbala
laakhon qaatilon mein tha
magar ye sach hai ba khuda
koi na hussain aur
khuda ke darmiyan tha
sajde mein hussain thay
labon pe thi yehi sada
<<DIVIDER>>
le ay mere allah ab tere hawale
maalik tera banda ab tere hawale
aray zindagi se ser ho chuka
kar raha hoon aakhri sajda
hussain hussain ya hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
allah allah allah
subhana rabbi yal aa'laa

aakhri dena hai mujhe imtehan

hai ye mere qatl ki tayyariyan
